text: Now listen to a story. It is called Our School.
My name is Selam. I am in Grade 3. Our school is near the river. It has a big green gate and a small café.
Every morning, my friend Dawit and I walk to school.
We take our books to the library on Tuesday. In the laboratory, we look at seeds and leaves.
I love my school because the teachers are kind.
Question! What colour is the school gate? Yes, it is green!
